question: What kind of house door must those seeking auspiciousness never construct?
premises: A door aligned along the beam is specified.
It must not be made at all.
This prohibition applies to seekers of auspiciousness.
inference: Those seeking auspiciousness must avoid constructing a house door aligned along the beam.
uncertainties: The exact structural sense of anuvaṃśa is technical.
plain_english: Those who seek auspiciousness should never make a house door aligned along the beam.
